title: Mixed Event — We Escape to Survive — Episode6 My Way

meta.Event Outline: With Mafuyu's contact with the group restricted, the rest of N25 think what they can do for her. Hoping to give her some peace of mind, Mizuki comes up with a plan...

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I thought I'd be able to relax a little if I came here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But it's not working...
My brain just won't cool it.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Is everything okay...?
You don't look very happy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Don't worry. I was just thinking about something...
Is that so...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You say you were just thinking about something, but your eyes tell a different story.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Were you two watching me this whole time? You could've said hi or something...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
S-Sorry...
Luka said we were just going to take a quick peek...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're no fun, Len. Spilling the beans like that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, Mizuki, what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The same thing as before...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to help Mafuyu, but haven't been able to come up with any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that really all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My guess is that you're not just thinking about Mafuyu, but also yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What made you think that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No reason in particular. Just my gut feeling.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, you're pretty much spot on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My mind keeps asking me, “Do you, of all people, think you can help Mafuyu?”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Finding a solution to all of Mafuyu's problems isn't going to be easy, so I thought I could at least provide a place for her to run...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A place for her to run?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I went through a really tough period way back when, but I was able to get through it because I had a place where I could run and feel safe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I thought if Mafuyu also had a place where she could run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But reminiscing about my past led me to ask myself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What right do I have trying to help her...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade's prepared to keep composing songs for Mafuyu until she saves her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena said she'd wait for as long as she needs to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And what about you, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't commit like them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because all I ever did was run away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't deal with my own problems, and I really don't know how to talk to my friends about stuff that really matters... Even though I really don't want to lose them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're such a coward, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
L-Luka...
You don't have to say it like that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha... No, she's right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really am a coward...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, you are.
But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Isn't there something you can do because you're the way you are?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You say that you're not capable of helping her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I believe there's something you can do specifically because you ran from everything until now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just look at things from a slightly different perspective.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right now, whether she likes it or not, Mafuyu has to face her biggest problems all at once...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you have a first-hand understanding of just how painful this process is going to be, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When you felt you were about to break, what did you do?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How did you protect yourself?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When I was about to break...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Back then...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (When it felt like the real me was gonna disappear forever... That was unbelievably painful...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At school, even when I was with my classmates, no one understood... I was all alone...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is why I wanted to get away from there.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Lucky for me, Mom, Dad and Sis showed genuine concern for my well-being...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They kept me afloat.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I ended up okay because...
I ran and ran and kept running.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And then...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I met the others.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As I made music videos with them, I gradually became more comfortable with expressing how I really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I felt that I could just be myself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It was a small glimmer, but I found the light at the end...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's okay to run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to tell her that it's okay to run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Or shout, “Run!”
“It's okay to run away from this place!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that there's a safe place where you can run to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? All I did was suggest that you look at things from a slightly different perspective.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't know if this is actually gonna help Mafuyu at all...)
